claim: The sample demo never reads or writes real invoice records
where: first-screen demo action, demo banner, privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real record, enter ?demo=1, modify demo, then return to the real database

claim: The selected due rule calculates and displays the due date
where: invoice form, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh demo; enter a fixed issued date and select 30-day terms; assert the exact calendar result

claim: A monthly CSV contains one row per included invoice and seals its recorded dates
where: export dialog, how it works, README, terms
sandbox: fresh three-invoice demo; export August 2026; inspect file rows and the resulting sealed state

claim: Restoring an older backup cannot change dates already sealed by an export
sandbox: download pre-export demo backup, seal the month, restore the older backup, and assert issued and sent inputs stay disabled

claim: An invalid backup is rejected before it changes invoice records
sandbox: fresh demo; restore a structurally valid-looking file with an invalid IANA zone; reload and assert only the sample invoices remain

claim: Invoice records can be edited offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh demo; wait for service worker, go offline, reload, add a sent date, and reload again

claim: Demo invoice actions send no invoice data to another origin
sandbox: record every request during demo editing and backup; assert every request is same-origin

claim: A passphrase-encrypted backup hides invoice text and restores locally
sandbox: fresh demo; download encrypted backup, inspect ciphertext, and restore with the passphrase

claim: The ₹699 one-time PDF plan stores PDFs only with a verified license
where: first-screen price fact, PDF plan, terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo with a recorded valid verdict; attach a PDF, reload, and assert the stored attachment is available

claim: The app reads invoice fields from a PDF locally and leaves them editable
where: first-screen import action, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh demo; provide a generated invoice PDF and assert extracted reference and amount in editable fields

claim: A stale tab cannot erase a newer recorded invoice date
sandbox: two demo tabs edit one invoice; first records sent, second submits stale note, then assert conflict and retained sent date
